title: Eclectica
description: Eclectic meaning something consisting of many things of different sorts. In short, it is a variety mod containing weapons, particles and blocks
body:
Eclectica is a mod made for HackCraft:YSWS

Adds a variety of new features including blocks, items and weapons

The following is an image of the mods coins and dollars as well as coin piles
![Preview of coin piles, dollars and coins](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/46809e7a845890d8ba7886cdf129aea3e5a3e208.png)

# All Features
These are all the items the mod features currently, visuals of all of the following are available in the gallery
- Mushroom Scythe
- Coins, Dollars and Coin piles
- Pink Block Set
- Bounce Pads
- Tear of Heaven (Food)
- Junk (Fuel)
